 Filing Extension for the Submission of Country-by-Country Notifications 
The Barbados Revenue Authority (“the Authority”) advises Multinational Enterprise (“MNE”) Groups that an extension has been granted until Friday, January 31, 2025, to facilitate the submission of Country-by-Country (“CbC”) Notifications for any MNE Group whose fiscal year ended between October 1 – December 31, 2024.

Click here to download Guidance Note - CbC Filing Notification Extension for the Submission of Country-by-Country Notifications
